note: Summaries are original-wording paraphrases of Core Rules mechanics, written for these in-app tooltips — not rulebook text. When editing, re-verify the mechanics (DNs, durations, effects) against the book, and keep the wording original.
categoryNote: category drives condition-chip theming (D19): damage = ongoing harm, affliction = mind/toxin effects, impairment = restrictions and penalties.
general: A condition tracks a way of being hurt or hampered that isn't plain Wound damage.
The GM may let a condition lapse when the scene closes; some hang on until they're treated.
Suffering the same condition again adds ranks, and ranked penalties add up — Hindered (2) means +2 DN, Bleeding (3) means 3 Mortal Wounds a turn.
When different conditions impose similar penalties, they don't combine — apply only the harshest one.
Defence never drops below 1, and you can't voluntarily act in a way that would take it lower.

conditions.name: Bleeding
conditions.summary: Each rank deals 1 Mortal Wound as your turn ends. Stop the bleeding by passing a DN 4 Toughness test, or when an ally tends you with Medicae.

conditions.name: Blinded
conditions.summary: Sight fails you: +4 DN on anything that needs vision — every Combat test included — overriding any lesser sight penalty. The GM may allow a Combat Action to clear it.

conditions.name: Exhausted
conditions.summary: You're spent: only Walk/Crawl, a basic attack, or Fall Back, with no Determination rolls — and any Shock you'd take becomes Mortal Wounds instead. Ends once you recover Shock (or as its source dictates).

conditions.name: Fear
conditions.summary: Test Resolve against the source's DN. Fail, and every test is at +2 DN until the scene ends or an ally passes a Leadership (Wil) test to steady you. Beings that cause Fear are themselves immune to Fear and Intimidation.

conditions.name: Frenzied
conditions.summary: Fury takes over: you must charge the nearest enemy you can see and swing with All-Out Attacks. You get +1 Strength, immunity to Fear, and can't be Pinned. At the start of your turn, a DN 3 Willpower test shakes it off.

conditions.name: Hindered
conditions.summary: +1 DN on every test per rank — Hindered (2) is +2 DN. Wears off at the end of your next turn unless its source says otherwise.

conditions.name: On Fire
conditions.summary: The flames deal 1d3 Mortal Wounds as each of your turns starts. Spend your Action to drop Prone and douse them (DN 3 Athletics) — or fight on, testing DN 3 Willpower to avoid becoming Hindered.

conditions.name: Pinned
conditions.summary: Suppressing fire has you: you can't leave cover (if caught in the open, you move to the nearest), other actions remain possible, and firing back at whoever pinned you is +2 DN. An ally's Leadership test rallies you free.

conditions.name: Poisoned
conditions.summary: The toxin puts +2 DN on every test. It ends with Medicae treatment, or by passing a Toughness test (DN set by the poison) as your turn starts.

conditions.name: Prone
conditions.summary: You're on the ground: Defence -2 against enemies within 5m, but +1 Defence against attacks from 6m or beyond. Getting up is a Free Action, though you're limited to Standard Movement that turn.

conditions.name: Restrained
conditions.summary: Held fast: your Movement is unavailable and your Defence drops by 2.

conditions.name: Staggered
conditions.summary: You reel: Speed is halved when you move, and Running or Sprinting is impossible. Lasts through the end of your next turn.

conditions.name: Terror
conditions.summary: Test Resolve against the source's DN. Failure inflicts everything Fear does, and you must spend every action fleeing until the source is out of your line of sight. Fear immunities and bonuses count against Terror too.

conditions.name: Vulnerable
conditions.summary: Your guard is open: Defence -1, and certain effects deepen the penalty. Gone at the end of your next turn.
